scope: Shipped module folders and first-party PHP source candidates. No module is loaded. Installed/enabled modules in a deployment are a separate observation. Private runtime configuration, dependency code and translations are excluded.
limitations: Lexical references are candidates, not a runtime call graph or a confirmed bug.
Public controller methods are not a proven route/verb contract.
Storage policy is not proof that each consumer uses the company adapter.
Admin route denial does not make a feature operational.
Job/report candidates need positive and negative proofs through their actual entry points.
